## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in Codex Controller.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `swift test --package-path native`
- [ ] `npm run build:all`
- [ ] Hardware behavior was tested or is explicitly marked unverified

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] The change does not broaden Accessibility, Input Monitoring, microphone, filesystem, or URL access without documentation and tests
- [ ] No credentials, private Codex data, controller identifiers, or copyrighted third-party assets are included
